The year petrol hit R30 ⛽📈

Inland 95 went from R20.10 in February to a record R30.25 in October. Strikes on Iran pushed oil above $100 a barrel, a R3 a litre levy cut (costing R17.2bn) softened April to June, and inflation climbed to 5% in June. The Reserve Bank hiked rates in May and September.

From 4 November: R1.50 off petrol and R3 off diesel until December.

How much has your monthly fuel bill changed this year? 👇

Sources: DMPR monthly prices, Stats SA CPI, National Treasury (MTBPS).
